long_biography.plain_text:
Buying a majority of National Equipment Dealers in 2023 took beverage distributor John J. Taylor III into heavy machinery. He and fellow executive Zack Kavanaugh were attracted by its experienced management team and relationships with family-owned manufacturers. They visited all eighteen branches during their first eight months as owners, introducing changes to medical insurance and service technicians' pay.

The acquisition also brought practical problems, including excess inventory and underused rental machines. Their response included repairing idle equipment and returning it to rental service. Later investment included an air-conditioned repair workshop in Apopka, replacing outdoor working conditions with eight drive-through service bays.
